privacy.ai_training_note: Genesys explicitly states: 'Genesys does not use customer communications — such as audio, video, chat, screen recordings, attachments or metadata — to train shared or third-party AI models.' AI systems are designed to use data minimally, isolate systems, and never train shared models on customer personal data.
privacy.data_region: Customer-selectable; customers choose the Genesys Cloud region where their organization resides, which also serves as the storage location for their data. Optional voice recording storage via Global Media Fabric can be configured to a separate Genesys Cloud Satellite Media Region.

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: AES 256-bit encryption for data at rest

security.name: Key management
security.value: Unique encryption keys per customer with Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) capability available

security.name: Data isolation
security.value: All customer instances logically separated; data access pathways isolated between customers

security.name: AI Ethics governance
security.value: Cross-functional AI Ethics Board with roles assigned for each step of AI lifecycle; privacy-by-design approach embedded throughout

products.name: Genesys Cloud CX
products.data_scope: Customer communications (voice, chat, email, text, social), interaction metadata, recordings (optional), contact history
products.notes: Core unified platform; omnichannel contact center with AI, analytics, workforce management, and integrations with Salesforce, ServiceNow and 1000+ marketplace apps.

products.name: Genesys Cloud AI Agents
products.data_scope: Customer interactions and context data for agent reasoning and decision-making
products.notes: Agentic AI that can reason, act and adapt across customer experiences; does not train on customer data for shared models.

products.name: Genesys Cloud Analytics
products.data_scope: Interaction data, text and speech analytics, event data for customer journeys
products.notes: Real-time optimization and compliance reporting via text/speech analytics; customer data remains under customer control.

compare.pricing_model: SaaS subscription (per-user or per-interaction models available)
compare.data_residency: Customer-selectable regions (multi-region support); compliance with GDPR, HIPAA, FedRAMP data residency requirements
